core_model.name: CMRP-MSA
core_model.fusion: not part of core claim; F2 is auxiliary ablation only; F3 is failure analysis only

locked_interpretation.en: B3 reduces the average cross-missing representation drift and slightly alleviates performance degradation, with the most evident improvements observed under text-related missing patterns.
locked_interpretation.zh: B3 能够在总体上降低跨缺失模式的表征漂移并缓解性能退化，但其收益具有明显的缺失模式依赖性，在文本相关缺失场景下更为明显。
locked_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Do not claim B3 eliminates representation drift under all missing patterns, nor that CMRP outperforms HME/CMAD/EASE/RECAP.
locked_interpretation.causal_strength: consistent co-improvement of D_cross and Delta-MAE/Corr; not a strict causal proof

research_story.RQ: When the available modality set changes, how can a multimodal sentiment model preserve the task-relevant structure of its high-level representation?
research_story.target: D_cross down while MAE/Corr do not worsen
research_story.chain: Mask -> H0 -> discover D_cross -> B3 -> D_cross down (+ mild Delta-MAE/Corr down)
